source_text: Οἱ ἐν Βιέννῃ καὶ Λουγδούνῳ τῆς Γαλλίας παροικοῦντες δοῦλοι Χριστοῦ, τοῖς κατὰ τὴν Ἀσίαν καὶ Φρυγίαν τὴν αὐτὴν τῆς ἀπολυτρώσεως ἡμῖν πίστιν καὶ ἐλπίδα ἔχουσιν ἀδελφοῖς, εἰρήνη καὶ χάρις καὶ δόξα ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς καὶ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν.
thought_title: Greeting to fellow Christians in Asia and Phrygia
orientation: The Christians of Lyons and Vienne open their letter by addressing fellow Christians in Asia and Phrygia.
pass_a_gloss: Those sojourning in Vienne and Lyons of Gaul, servants of Christ, to those throughout Asia and Phrygia, brothers and sisters in faith having the same faith and hope of redemption as we have, peace and grace and glory from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

pass_b_english: From the servants of Christ sojourning in Vienne and Lyons of Gaul to the brothers and sisters in faith in Asia and Phrygia who share with us the same faith and hope of redemption: peace and grace and glory from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
